ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from picking up a product category for AEM Unauthenticated Enquiry Cases other than Home loans, Cheque/Savings accounts, or Not product related.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), ISNEW(), RecordType.DeveloperName = "General_Inquiry_CMOS", ISPICKVAL(Origin, "ANZ Plus Web"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(IDR_Product_Category__c, "Home loans")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(IDR_Product_Category__c, "Cheque/Savings accounts")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(IDR_Product_Category__c, "Not product related")), ANZx_Customer__c = true )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The product category of an AEM Unauthenticated Enquiry Case should be either Home loans, Cheque/Savings accounts, or Not product related.
